Chromosome 15 — Dense Regional LD Heatmap

PBS candidate locus region, phased r² matrix, 799 SNPs, Uzbek cohort (n=1,090) — matches the chr18 visual standard (P3)

Computed 2026-05-04 (UZB region matrix), 2026-04-24 (whole-chr overview) Published 2026-09-20
This page closes the roadmap item “chr15/chr9 dense regional LD matrices” (Priority Roadmap #3 / Submission Blocker P3). The underlying computation already existed on DRAGEN (dense phased r² matrix from plink2 --r2-phased, 799×799 SNPs spanning the PBS candidate region; whole-chromosome UZB vs EUR overview from a separate LD-decay run) — this page is the first time it has been visualized and published.

A. Whole-chromosome overview (UZB vs EUR mean r² per window)

B. Dense regional LD heatmap (799×799 SNPs, phased r², UZB cohort)

Hover a cell to see the SNP pair and exact r² value. This is the same computation type (plink2 --r2-phased, square matrix) used for the published chr18 page.

Scope note: this dense matrix is UZB-only (the region-specific run did not include a second population). The whole-chromosome overview above (panel A) does carry the UZB vs EUR comparison. A UZB vs EUR dense matrix for this specific region would need a fresh plink2 --r2-phased run restricted to the EUR keep-list — not yet done.

Source: DRAGEN (Biotech2024) /staging/ALSU-analysis/spring2026/ld_regional_exact/chr15_uzb_region.phased.vcor2 (region matrix, computed 2026-05-04) and /staging/ALSU-analysis/spring2026/ld_cmp/chr15/window.tsv (whole-chromosome overview, computed 2026-04-24). Published 2026-09-20 after being located during a roadmap audit — the analysis existed but had never been surfaced.
